group.name: Lethal Gargoyles will NOT load without these

plugin.name: Four required mods - none of the libraries is on Nexus
plugin.description:
Lethal Gargoyles needs four other mods. If any is missing the game still starts, the Gargoyle simply will not be there, and your BepInEx log will say "missing dependencies".
1. BepInEx 5 (5.4.2100) 2. LethalLib, by Evaisa 3. PathfindingLib, by Zaggy1024 4. Concentus, by qwbarch
IMPORTANT: none of those three is on Nexus, and LethalLib needs three more packages of its own - HookGenPatcher (you may see it called MMHOOK), MonoDetour, and MonoDetour_BepInEx_5. That is six you have to download from Thunderstore and copy in by hand - Vortex cannot do it for you. BepInEx itself is the exception: Vortex installs that one automatically.
https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/Evaisa/LethalLib/ https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/Zaggy1024/PathfindingLib/ https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/qwbarch/Concentus/ https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/Evaisa/HookGenPatcher/ https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/MonoDetour/MonoDetour/ https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/MonoDetour/MonoDetour_BepInEx_5/
THEY DO NOT ALL GO IN THE SAME FOLDER, so do not just tip them into plugins. The step by step is on the mod page, and in the "READ ME FIRST - Manual Install" file inside this download. The short version: LethalLib's "plugins" folder, HookGenPatcher's "patchers" and "config", and MonoDetour's "core" and "patchers" all go inside your BepInEx folder, while PathfindingLib.dll and Concentus go into BepInEx\plugins.
You can finish this installer first and add them afterwards - order does not matter, only that everything is present before you play.
OPTIONAL, for extra content rather than to make the mod work:
Coroner - the Gargoyle gets his own cause-of-death messages, and taunts you about how you died last round. Tick the box on the next page if you use it.
Finally: this is a host AND client mod. Everyone in the lobby needs it installed, or the Gargoyle will not spawn correctly.

plugin.name: Coroner death messages
plugin.description:
Adds the Gargoyle's custom cause-of-death lines to Coroner, so the end of round report says how he got you instead of showing a generic death.
Only does anything if you also run Coroner. It is a small text file and it is harmless to install either way, so leave it ticked unless you want an untouched Coroner config.
